name: ecocircuit-greenloop-fullstack
description: EcoCircuit / Green Loop — AI-Enhanced Circular E-Waste Platform (Complete Fullstack)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend install && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.build:frontend: npm --prefix frontend install && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
